problem_description: Summer bookings sat unconfirmed for over two weeks because host families were recruited only after the placement offer went out.
action_taken: Started host recruitment for the summer intake in February and kept a rolling list of pre-vetted families.
outcome: Average time to confirmation dropped from 16 days to 5 the following season.

problem_description: A batch of group bookings stalled before confirmation while one coordinator chased the same three host families.
action_taken: Introduced a weekly review of every booking still unconfirmed seven days after the placement offer, reallocating chases to whoever had capacity.
outcome: Stalled bookings were spotted within a week instead of surfacing at invoicing.

problem_description: Bookings from one sending organisation waited on confirmation because the host stipend rate had not been agreed.
action_taken: Agreed stipend rates with the sending organisation before the season opened and published them to the host list.
outcome: Worked for that organisation, but rate queries from new partners still caused occasional stalls.

problem_description: Confirmations queued behind a single inbox that only the placements coordinator checked.
action_taken: Set up a shared confirmations inbox monitored by two staff with an out-of-office handover rule.
outcome: No booking waited more than three working days on an unread host reply.

problem_description: Peak-season bookings were confirmed late because host availability was checked one family at a time by phone.
action_taken: Sent a single availability form to all hosts at the start of each season and recorded responses on the tracker.
outcome: Matching worked from a live availability list; the phone rounds were dropped.

problem_description: Several autumn bookings breached the confirmation target when two host families withdrew in the same week.
action_taken: Kept a standby pool of three vetted host families per season to absorb late withdrawals.
outcome: Subsequent withdrawals were re-covered within two days without breaching the target.

problem_description: Student CVs and consent letters were requested a second time after the spring sheet was forked for summer bookings.
action_taken: Added a received-documents checklist to the booking row and carried open bookings into the new season's sheet instead of re-entering them.
outcome: Document re-requests fell to near zero the following intake.

problem_description: Documents arrived by email and were saved to personal folders, so colleagues re-requested files that already existed.
action_taken: Created one shared folder per booking reference and made saving to it part of the intake step.
outcome: Staff could see at a glance what had arrived; duplicate requests stopped.

problem_description: Sending organisations were asked twice for medical consent forms because the tracker had no column for them.
action_taken: Added a consent-form column with received dates to the tracker.
outcome: The second-ask emails stopped, though older bookings still needed a manual back-fill.

problem_description: A temp covering the placements desk re-requested documents because the handover notes did not say where files were kept.
action_taken: Wrote a one-page desk guide covering where documents live and how the checklist is read.
outcome: The next cover period ran without duplicate requests.

problem_description: Documents were re-requested whenever bookings were transferred between coordinators mid-season.
action_taken: Made the document checklist part of the transfer email template.
outcome: Transfers stopped triggering re-requests.

problem_description: Passport copies were requested again at pre-arrival even when collected at booking.
action_taken: Trialled having hosts verify passports on arrival instead of collecting copies twice.
outcome: Dropped after one season — hosts found verification awkward and copies went back to being collected at booking.

problem_description: Confirmed placements were re-allocated when host families dropped out within a fortnight of arrival.
action_taken: Re-confirmed host availability at the point of matching rather than relying on season-start signup.
outcome: Late drop-outs fell by more than half the next season.

problem_description: A work-placement company withdrew after students were matched, forcing re-allocation of a whole group.
action_taken: Asked partner companies to confirm capacity in writing four weeks before arrival.
outcome: Group withdrawals were caught early enough to re-match calmly.

problem_description: Re-allocations were done under time pressure because no reserve hosts existed.
action_taken: Held back two vetted host families per season as a dedicated reserve.
outcome: Re-allocations were absorbed without emergency phone rounds.

problem_description: The same host family caused repeated re-allocations across seasons before anyone noticed the pattern.
action_taken: Logged a fall-through reason against the host record every time a placement was re-allocated.
outcome: Repeat offenders were spotted and retired from the list.

problem_description: Students were re-placed after arrival because room arrangements did not match what was promised.
action_taken: Added a pre-season home visit for first-time host families.
outcome: Post-arrival moves became rare, though the visits stretched staff time in peak weeks.

problem_description: Re-allocation emails went out without updating the tracker, so invoices were raised against the old host.
action_taken: Made the tracker update part of the re-allocation email checklist.
outcome: Invoice corrections stopped.

problem_description: Visa appointments for one nationality ran six weeks behind, compressing pre-arrival logistics.
action_taken: Moved booking deadlines earlier for the affected nationalities.
outcome: Arrivals stopped landing before their paperwork cleared.

problem_description: Invoices went out weeks after confirmation because billing details were collected late.
action_taken: Collected billing details on the booking form itself.
outcome: Invoices went out with the confirmation.

problem_description: Airport transfers were double-booked on peak Saturdays.
action_taken: Moved transfer bookings onto a single shared calendar.
outcome: Double-bookings stopped.

problem_description: Placement offers went out with out-of-date host profiles attached.
action_taken: Regenerated host profiles from the tracker at offer time.
outcome: Complaints about mismatched profiles stopped.

problem_description: Welcome packs were posted too late to arrive before students flew.
action_taken: Switched welcome packs to email with a printed copy handed over at arrival.
outcome: Every student had the pack before travelling.

problem_description: The office printer jammed daily during peak season.
action_taken: Replaced the printer and moved label printing to the front desk.
outcome: Printing complaints stopped.

problem_description: Staff missed messages spread across text, email and calls.
action_taken: Introduced a Monday morning stand-up for the placements team.
outcome: Fewer things slipped between channels.

problem_description: Season-end filing took a full week of staff time.
action_taken: Agreed a fixed folder structure and archived by booking reference.
outcome: Filing dropped to under a day.
